summary: Comprehensive testing of NexUacademy Teacher Dashboard, Student Features, and Notification System. All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing completed successfully with all key features working: Teacher login/dashboard, Schedule Class dialog with batch selection, Create Test multi-step form with questions, View Students with batch filtering, Student Dashboard with quick navigation, Assigned Tests page, My Classes page, Notification Bell, and Signup with batch selector.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test data created and cleaned up within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teacher dashboard with stats cards (Total Classes, Total Tests, Students count, Drafts) and quick action cards. Schedule New Class dialog has Title, Subject, Platform, Meeting Link, Date, Time, Duration, Assign to Batches (6 predefined JEE batches: 2027/2028/2029 - Morning/Evening), Description fields. Create Test is 3-step form: Step 1 (Test details with batch selection), Step 2 (Add questions with Teacher Note field - shown only after submission for incorrect), Step 3 (Preview & Publish). View Students shows student cards with batch filter dropdown. Student can access: Dashboard, Assigned Tests, My Classes. Both layouts have notification bell that shows empty panel when no notifications. Signup page shows batch selector dropdown for student role (hidden for teacher role).
